controls.label: Presentation controls
presenter.countdownTooltip: Planned time left: total of the time plan minus the timer
presenter.spotlightTooltip: Spotlight follows the mouse over the slide; mouse wheel or + / −: size
presenter.zoomTooltip: Zoom follows the mouse over the slide; mouse wheel or + / −: zoom level
presenter.chaptersTooltip: Show or hide the chapter list (or hover over the right edge)
presenter.projectorTooltip: Move the audience window to the projector
presenter.clicksOne: The next click goes to the next slide
presenter.clicksMany: {clicks} clicks left before the next slide
presenter.blankScreen: Audience screen is black · press B to show it
notes.none: No notes for this slide. Add <aside class="speaker-notes"> to it.
pace.waitingForFirstNext: Plan {time} · timer starts with the first Next
chapters.title: Chapters
chapters.hint: hover here, or C to keep open
keys.title: Keys
keys.hint: hover here, or K to keep open
keys.exitPresenter: End spotlight or zoom; then leave this view
keys.presenter: Presenter view (again: reopen the audience window)
keys.motion: Animations on / off (only when Windows reduces motion)
slides.title: Slides
slides.hint: hover here, or G to keep open · click a slide to go there
texts.title: Texts
texts.hint: hover here, or T to keep open
texts.note: Changes show at once (also on the projector) and are saved in this browser. Save a copy writes them into a new presentation file. Keep {name} parts in interface texts as they are.
texts.saveCopy: Save a copy with these changes
texts.resetOne: Back to the text in the file
checks.audienceConnectedTip: The audience window answers and shows this slide.
checks.audienceClosedTip: Open it again with P or the button.
checks.audienceNotRespondingTip: The audience window does not answer: it froze, or it shows another page. Reconnect opens it again or brings it back.
checks.audienceOtherSlideTip: The audience window shows another slide than this one. Resync brings it back to this slide.
checks.audienceFullscreenTip: The audience window fills its screen.
checks.audienceNotFullscreenTip: Click the audience window and press F (or use the Projector button first).
checks.oneScreenTip: Only one screen is connected. Connect the projector (Windows key + P: Extend).
checks.awakeTip: The screen does not dim or lock while this presentation is open.
checks.mightSleepTip: The browser did not keep the screen awake. Click the window once, or check the Windows power settings.
checks.batteryTip: Not charging. Plug in the power cable for the talk.
checks.batteryChargingTip: The power cable is plugged in.
checks.fontsTip: The fonts of the presentation are loaded.
checks.fontsMissingTip: A font could not be loaded: texts use a replacement font. Build the file again with build.py.
checks.animationsOffTip: Windows asks for less animation, so slides show their end state at once. Press M to turn the animations on.
checks.scriptErrorsTip: A slide script failed; the slides keep working. Last error: {last}. Details are in the browser console (F12).
audience.fullscreenHint: Click here or press F for full screen
toast.scriptError: A slide script failed (details in the console, F12). Next and Back keep working.
toast.animationsOffAtStart: Animations are off in the Windows settings. Press M to turn them on for this presentation.
toast.printNeedsFile: Print and PDF work in the downloaded HTML file (Chrome or Edge), not inside a web page.
toast.printNotAllowed: Printing is not allowed here. Open the downloaded HTML file in Chrome or Edge.
toast.presenterNeedsFile: Presenter view needs the downloaded HTML file. Open it in Chrome or Edge and press P.
toast.popupBlocked: The browser blocked the audience window. Allow pop-ups for this file, then press P again.
toast.audienceDidNotConnect: The audience window did not connect. Open the downloaded file directly in Chrome or Edge and press P.
toast.oneScreenOnly: Only one screen found. Connect the projector, then try again.
toast.audienceNotOpen: The audience window is not open. Press P first.
toast.sentToProjector: Sent to the other screen. Check the projector, then click the audience window and press F.
toast.moveNotAllowed: The browser did not allow moving the window. Drag it to the projector instead.
toast.themesBlockBroken: The THEMES block in the HTML is not valid, so the built-in themes are missing. Check it for a missing quote or an extra comma.
toast.importNotRecognized: Import failed: {file} is not a time plan, realized-times file, theme or texts file exported by this presentation.
toast.importFailed: Import failed: {file} could not be read ({error}).
toast.themeNameNeeded: Type a name for the theme first.
toast.themeNameBuiltIn: "{name}" is a built-in theme. Choose another name.
toast.noRealizedTimes: No finished slides of at least {seconds} s yet.
confirm.resetTimer: Reset the timer? The realized slide times of this run are cleared (export them first in Settings).
confirm.importThemeLosesColours: Your changed colours are not saved as a theme. Import this theme anyway?
confirm.switchThemeLosesColours: Your changed colours are not saved as a theme. Switch to "{name}" anyway?
confirm.useRealizedTimes: Replace the planned time of {count} slides with the realized time? (The slide on screen and slides shown less than {seconds} s keep their plan.)
confirm.reloadForTemplates: This reloads the presentation: the realized slide times of this run are lost and the audience window must be reopened (P). Continue?
confirm.resetTexts: Undo all text changes made in this browser (slide texts and interface texts)?
import.runReport: {count} realized slide times are now the plan
import.textsSkipped: ({count} skipped: their text in this file is different now)
error.copyBlocksMissing: the THEMES block, the interface texts block or the deck element is missing in the HTML
source.thisBrowser: This browser has its own {what} for this presentation; they win over the values in the file. The Reset and Undo buttons go back to the file.
source.file: Using the theme, times and texts written in the file.
settings.title: Settings
settings.themeNote: Pick a theme, or change single colours. Changes apply at once and are saved in this browser (also for the audience window).
settings.timesNote: Minutes:seconds (1:30) or seconds (90). The presenter view uses this plan to show if you are ahead or behind. Backup slides are not part of the plan.
settings.realizedSoFar: Realized so far: {actual} over {slides} slides (planned for those slides: {planned}). The slide on screen is still counting.
settings.realizedExplained: Realized times are measured by the presenter view timer: press P and present, then export them here. Export before you close the window: they are not saved.
settings.importNote: Import takes a time plan, a realized-times file (JSON; its real times of finished slides of at least 5 s become the new plan), a theme or a texts file. The Excel file has number columns in seconds you can calculate with.
settings.textsNote: Change the texts of the slides and of the interface in the presenter view (P), in the Texts drawer at the left edge (T). Export texts saves every text in one file; Import a file reads it back.
settings.spotlightNote: L turns the spotlight on and off. While it shows, the mouse wheel or the + and − keys make the circle bigger or smaller; the size below is where it starts. Saved in this browser.
settings.spotlightFollow: Show the spotlight by itself while the mouse moves over the slide, and hide it when the mouse stops. Handy with a remote that moves the mouse, such as a Logitech Spotlight without its software.
settings.printNote: Every slide in its final state, in the current theme. In the print window, choose "Save as PDF" as the printer to get a PDF. Tip: the Light theme uses much less ink.
settings.printSlides: Print or save as PDF: slides
settings.printHandout: Print or save as PDF: handout with notes
settings.fileNote: Save a copy of this presentation with the current theme, all themes, the time plan and the changed texts written into the file itself. Use that copy on any computer.
settings.saveCopy: Save a copy with these settings
settings.saveCopyEmbedded: Save a copy works in the downloaded HTML file (Chrome or Edge), not inside a web page.
components.qrTooLong: This link is too long for a QR code (at most 213 characters).
components.agendaMissing: The agenda points to a slide that does not exist: {name}
images.note: Drop an image file onto an image of the large slide, or use Replace…. The new image shows at once (also on the projector) and is kept in this browser; Save a copy writes it into the file.
images.reset: Back to the image in the file
toast.notAnImage: That is not an image file. Use a .jpg, .png, .webp, .gif or .svg file.
toast.boothStarted: Booth mode: the presentation plays by itself. Press any key or click to stop.
toast.captionsUnsupported: Live captions need Chrome or Edge.
toast.captionsNoMicrophone: Live captions stopped: the browser may not use the microphone. Allow it in the address bar, then switch captions on again.
toast.captionsNoInternet: Live captions stopped: the speech recognition needs internet.
settings.boothNote: The presentation plays by itself and starts again after the last slide, for a screen at a stand. Clicks inside a slide come every 4 s. Any key, click or touch stops it. Also: open the file with ?booth=20 at the end of the address.
settings.captionsNote: What you say appears as subtitles at the bottom of the slides, also on the projector. It uses the browser's speech recognition: Chrome and Edge send the sound of your microphone to Google or Microsoft for this, so it needs internet. Off until you switch it on; it stops when you close the window.
settings.captionsUnsupported: This browser has no speech recognition. Use Chrome or Edge.
components.qrEmpty: Put a link in data-qr (or in the Texts drawer: QR code link).
toast.imageNotSaved: Image replaced by {file}, but this browser could not save it: it is gone after a reload. Save a copy keeps it.
toast.captionsLanguage: Live captions stopped: this language is not available for speech recognition here.
toast.captionsStopped: Live captions stopped: the speech recognition keeps stopping. Check the microphone and the internet connection.
editor.title: Editor
editor.playTooltip: Opens the edited presentation in a new tab, on this slide
editor.settingsTooltip: Theme, colours, times, spotlight and more (they are saved with the file)
editor.chooseTemplate: Add a slide: choose a layout
editor.statusSaved: All changes are in the file
editor.statusUnsaved: Not saved yet (a draft is kept in this browser)
editor.scriptedNote: This slide has its own animation script. You can change its texts, numbers and images; its layout stays as it is.
editor.scriptedNoCopy: A slide with its own animation script cannot be duplicated: its script only knows the original.
editor.slideTitle: Slide title (shown in the chapter bar)
editor.slideNameNote: Lower-case letters, digits and dashes. Some slides have styles tied to their name.
editor.slideBackup: Extra slide (backup): not part of the talk; shown only when you open it (Slides drawer, chapter list)
editor.slideNotesNote: One line per paragraph. Start a line with "2: " to light it up at click 2.
editor.slideHint: Click a text on the slide to type; click any element to see its settings in the Element tab.
editor.deckStaggerNote: Items set to appear rise in one after another, this far apart.
editor.deckEnterDelay: Wait before the first item appears (ms)
editor.deckEnterDelayNote: After a new slide comes on.
editor.logoLarge: Large on the first and last slide
editor.deckNote: Presentation code: {id}. This browser keeps its settings under this code; Save as new file gives the new file a code of its own.
editor.badName: Use lower-case letters, digits and dashes for the name.
editor.nameTaken: Another slide already has that name.
editor.badNumber: That is not a number (use a point for decimals, e.g. 52.5).
editor.confirmDelete: Delete the slide "{title}"? (Undo brings it back.)
editor.restoreDraft: There are editor changes from {time} that were not saved. Continue with them? (Cancel starts from the file.)
editor.closedWithDraft: Your changes are kept as a draft in this browser. Open the editor (E) and Save to put them in the file.
editor.draftWaiting: There are unsaved editor changes. Press E to continue with them.
editor.pickThisFile: In the window that opens, choose this file, {file}, and confirm that it may be replaced. The browser remembers it afterwards.
editor.otherFileName: You chose {file}, not this file ({current}). Save there anyway? This page keeps showing {current}.
editor.notAllowed: The browser did not allow saving into the file. Try again and click Allow, or use Save as new file.
editor.savedElsewhere: Saved as {file}. You are still working in this file: open {file} to work in the new one.
editor.downloaded: This browser cannot save into files: {file} was downloaded instead. Use Chrome or Edge to save in place.
editor.embeddedNote: Inside a web page the editor cannot save. Open the downloaded HTML file in Chrome or Edge.
editor.dragToMove: Drag to move (Shift: only across or up and down). A block in the layout: drag it to another place in it, or out of it to place it freely
editor.dragToResize: Drag to resize (Ctrl: from the middle)
editor.altText: Alt text (what the picture shows, for screen readers)
editor.altTextNote: Says what the image shows, in a few words.
editor.chartRowsNote: One row per line: label: value. A * in front makes the row amber.
editor.agendaUntilNote: Empty: comes back after the first slide of the chapter.
editor.orderNote: Items rise in one after another in this order.
editor.animationShared: {count} elements use this animation: a change here changes all of them. Make a copy to change only this one.
editor.morphName: Glide name (the same name on the next slide glides)
editor.morphNote: The same name on the next or previous slide makes this element glide there.
editor.placeFreely: Place freely (drag it anywhere; arrow keys move it)
editor.exportCleanTooltip: A copy to share: it presents as this one, but has no editor (only your file keeps it)
editor.dockSlidesTooltip: The slides: rest the pointer here (📌 in it keeps it open)
editor.dockPanelTooltip: Element, layers, animations, slide and presentation: rest the pointer here (📌 in it keeps it open)
editor.pinTooltip: Keep it open (pin) / let it hide at the edge
editor.key_ctrlKText: Find any action by typing a few letters; also Go to a slide
cmd.title: Find an action or setting
cmd.placeholder: Type what you want to do or change (e.g. insert star, shadow, transparent, go to 5)…
cmd.overflowNow: The slide is too full now: something runs off its bottom edge (⚠ in the status bar selects it). Make something smaller, remove something, or Ctrl+Z.
cmd.needsClipboardLong: Nothing to paste yet: copy (Ctrl+C) or cut (Ctrl+X) an element first.
cmd.zoomedOutFully: The whole slide is already in view (Fit: Ctrl+0).
cmd.parent: Select the block that holds it
cmd.free: Move anywhere (place freely) / back into the layout
cmd.tabDeck: Show the All slides tab (theme, fonts, find and replace)
cmd.snap: Snap to the grid and guides on / off
cmd.exportClean: Save a copy to share (view only, without the editor)…
cmd.animate: Animate: In, Emphasis, Out (the pointer over one plays it)
cmd.hintDoubleClick: double-click anywhere: a text box there
cmd.hintInsert: + Insert (top bar): images, shapes, charts, lists …
editor.quickPick: Click an element on the slide: quick animations for it show here.
editor.recordTooltip: Record: move or turn a freely placed element on the slide; it becomes a key moment at the playhead
editor.recordOn: Recording: move or turn an element on the slide; it becomes a key moment at the red line.
editor.recordLater: Move the red line (click the ruler) to a later moment first.
editor.recordOnce: Record works for an animation that plays once (this one repeats).
editor.recordOneElement: Record works on one element at a time: click just one.
editor.recordSlideOnly: Record works for animations with the slide (this one plays on a click).
editor.rulerTooltip: Click or drag: the slide at that moment
editor.keyTooltip: Key moment at {at} % ({time} ms) · drag to another moment
editor.keyEnds: The first and last key moment: change the animation's delay or duration.
editor.segmentTooltip: How it moves here: {ease} · click to change
editor.keyEaseTooltip: How it moves from this key moment to the next
editor.easeBad: Not an easing: a cubic-bezier(x1, y1, x2, y2) with x between 0 and 1, or a name.
editor.pathDotTooltip: Key moment at {at} % · drag to move it, double-click to remove it (double-click the line: a key moment there)
editor.insertMenuTooltip: Add a text box, shape, image, list … to this slide
editor.insertAtEnd: At the end of the slide
editor.textNote: Select words in a text on the slide, then click Bold, Highlight or Plain. Enter finishes the text; Shift+Enter starts a new line.
editor.selectWordsFirst: Select a few words in a text on the slide first.
editor.newQuote: One sentence the audience should remember.
editor.largeFile: This file is {size} MB. It goes into the presentation file, which then becomes that much bigger. Continue?
editor.notWhilePresenting: The editor does not open while an audience window is open or booth mode runs. Close the audience window first.
editor.savedOtherFile: Saved in the file you chose. This page is an older copy, so your work is kept here as a draft too.
editor.previewCopy: This tab is a preview made by Play from here. Edit in the tab of the presentation file itself.
editor.newInfo: Choose a name and place for the new presentation. This presentation and your unsaved changes here stay as they are.
editor.appearByAnimation: This element plays its own animation: the animation decides how and when it appears (Animation below).
editor.animationsNote: Everything on this slide that appears or moves, in playing order. Change the order or the click number here, or drag a bar earlier or later; click a name to select it. ▶ Play slide shows the slide as in the presentation, Next click ▶ plays each click.
editor.tipsTooltip: Show or hide the explanations in this panel (a field's explanation also shows when you point at it)
editor.tipsOn: Tips on: the panel explains its settings.
editor.tipsOff: Tips off: point at a setting with ⓘ to read its explanation.
cmd.tips: Tips in the panel on / off
editor.nothingHere: Nothing appears with the slide: everything is there at once.
editor.noClicks: Nothing waits for a click. Choose "On a click" under How it appears (Element tab).
editor.imageFit: How the picture fills its box
editor.templateSaved: Saved as a template: it is in + Slide. Save the file to keep it.
editor.copyDone: Copied: Ctrl+V pastes (also on another slide).
editor.cutDone: Cut: Ctrl+V pastes (also on another slide).
editor.key_ctrlCText: Copy the selected element (with several selected: all of them)
editor.key_ctrlXText: Cut the selected element (with several selected: all of them)
editor.key_ctrlVText: Paste: a copied element, an image (e.g. a screenshot) or text as a text box
editor.key_ctrlDText: Duplicate the selected element (with several selected: all of them)
editor.key_deleteText: Delete the selected element (with several selected: all of them)
editor.key_arrowsText: Move a freely placed element by 1 px (10 px)
editor.key_enterText: Finish the text / new line in a text
editor.key_escapeText: Close the menu or window, stop playing, leave the text, deselect, close the editor
editor.key_f10Text: The keyboard on the menu bar: ← → menus, ↓ opens, Enter does it, Esc back
editor.key_f5Text: Play the presentation from this slide (a new tab)
cmd.styles: Text styles: a whole look in one click
cmd.stylePlain: Text style: Plain (as the slide design)
editor.drawPathTooltip: Then drag on the slide along the way it should go
editor.orientPathTooltip: A drawn path also turns the element with the way (an arrow points where it goes)
editor.drawPathPick: Click an element first, then draw its way.
editor.drawPathOn: Drag on the slide along the way the element should go. Esc stops.
editor.drawPathShort: That way is too short: drag a bit further.
editor.drawPathDone: Path made: {count} key moments. ▶ Play slide shows it; drag a dot to change it, double-click the line for one more.
editor.morphPairTooltip: Choose the element on the next slide this one glides into
editor.morphNoNext: This is the last slide: there is no next slide to glide to.
editor.morphPickNote: Slide {number}: click the element this one glides into.
editor.morphNothing: The next slide has no element to pair with.
editor.morphPaired: Paired: it glides into {label} on slide {number}.
editor.styleForAll: For all {count} selected: a field that says “mixed” differs between them; a choice gives them all the same.
cmd.align: Line them up or spread them
cmd.appearTogether: How they appear: one after another, each on a click, together on a click
editor.styleSaveTooltip: The look of the selected text (font, size, weight, colour, …) becomes a style of this file
editor.styleNamePlaceholder: Name of the style, then Enter (Esc: none)
editor.styleSaved: Style “{name}” saved in this file: one click gives a text this look.
editor.styleRemove: Remove the style “{name}” (texts that have it keep their look)
editor.paceTooltip: Time between items on this slide, in ms (empty: as the presentation)
editor.orderReadingTooltip: Items rise in from top to bottom, left to right on a line
editor.orderReverseTooltip: Items rise in from the last one (as you read) to the first
editor.tlResize: Drag to make the timeline higher or lower
editor.tlToggleTooltip: Show or hide the animation panel along the bottom (T)
editor.tlHide: Hide the timeline (T shows it again)
editor.tlKeyHereTooltip: A key moment for the selected element at the red line, with the values it shows there
editor.tlKeyHereNote: Put the red line on a moment (click the ruler of “With the slide”) and select an element with an animation of its own.
editor.tlKeyNeedsOwn: Key moments need an animation of its own: pick one in the Element tab, Animation (or use Draw a path or a quick animation).
editor.tlEmpty: Nothing on this part of the slide appears or moves. Give an element a way to appear (Element tab) or a quick animation (Animate).
editor.tlRulerClick: The red line works on “With the slide”
editor.tlExpand: Show its properties: one line each, with the key moments that set it
editor.tlStartTooltip: Drag: when it starts (its end stays)
editor.tlKeyTooltip: key moment at {time} ms · drag it to another moment, click to select (Delete removes it)
editor.tlOwnNote: drag: later or earlier; the ends: start and length
editor.tlOrderNote: drag: later or earlier (its order with the slide); the right end: how long it takes
editor.tlClickNote: the right end: how long it takes; its click: the number on the left
editor.tlShared: used by more elements: Copy for this element (Element tab, Animation) to change its timing here
editor.tlFixedNote: a video plays from its click
editor.tlKeyLast: An animation needs at least two key moments.
editor.tlGraphTooltip: Show the property lines as curves: drag a dot up or down for its value (Shift: only the value)
editor.tabCodeTooltip: The CSS of this element, this slide and the whole presentation, as the file holds it
editor.codeIntro: The same text the file holds: a field changes it here, a line typed here changes the fields. What you type shows at once; leaving the field (or Ctrl+Enter) keeps it, one undo step.
editor.codeElementPick: Click an element on the slide to see its style code.
editor.codeElementNote: Its style attribute, one property per line (font-size: 125%;). --x, --y, --w and --h are its place and size when placed freely. A line the browser does not know is left out.
editor.codeSlideNote: Rules that only reach this slide (they are kept in the slide as @scope { … }): :scope { … } is the slide itself, h2 { … } its headings.
editor.codeDeckNote: Rules for every slide (the CUSTOM CSS block, after the presentation's own CSS: they win). Start with .scene to reach the slides, e.g. .scene h2 { … }.
editor.codeSlideBroken: Not kept: a } too many would end this slide's rules early and reach every slide. Check the braces.
editor.htmlElementNote: As the file holds it. Leaving the field (or Ctrl+Enter) puts it in place: one element (its text, classes, attributes, what is inside). Scripts and on…="" are left out.
editor.htmlSlideNote: The whole slide as the file holds it: one <section class="scene">. Its data-name may change to a new free name. Leaving the field (or Ctrl+Enter) puts it in place.
editor.htmlOneRoot: This must be one element (one tag around everything): nothing kept yet.
editor.htmlNeedsSection: A slide is one <section class="scene" data-name="…">: nothing kept yet.
editor.htmlNotHere: A slide, a script or a style cannot replace an element: nothing kept yet.
editor.htmlScripts: {count} parts left out: scripts, frames, meta/base/link and CSS outside the slide (scripts get their own place)
editor.htmlChangedMeanwhile: The slide changed since this field was filled (e.g. you typed on it). Nothing was overwritten: click the field again for the HTML as it is now, then make your change.
toast.safeMode: Safe mode: this presentation's own scripts are off (?safe=1).
editor.jsSlideNote: Runs when this slide is presented: show.onEnter(fn), show.onStep(fn), show.onLeave(fn); show.every(ms, fn), show.after(ms, fn), show.on(element, event, fn) and show.add(element) end by themselves when the slide goes; show.find(…) looks in this slide; show.window says which window.
editor.jsDeckNote: Runs once when the presentation opens; its show.onEnter(fn) is called for every slide (fn(slide, { name })).
editor.jsRunTooltip: Plays the slide on the canvas with these scripts (a playing copy: what they do there is never saved)
editor.jsTrust: These scripts run when the presentation is shown, in both windows (show.window tells which). An error never stops the talk. Add ?safe=1 after the file name to open it with them all off.
editor.jsSafe: Safe mode (?safe=1): the presentation runs none of these scripts. ▶ still tries them here.
editor.jsNoScriptTag: write \x3C instead of < before script or !-- (it would end the script block in the file)
editor.codeRulesNote: What a style attribute cannot hold: &:hover { … } (under the pointer), & b { … } (its bold words), transition: … . They only reach this element (and its copies).
editor.codeRulesBroken: Not kept: a } too many would end this element's rules early. Check the braces.
editor.mineNone: none yet: an animation you make yourself (Element tab › Animation › ★ Keep) shows up here
editor.mineSaveTooltip: Keep this animation in this browser, for every presentation (Animations tab, Mine)
editor.mineSaved: In your animations: {name}. Any element, in any presentation: Animations tab, Mine.
editor.mineNothing: Select an element with an animation of its own first.
editor.mineReplace: You already have an animation called “{name}”. Replace it with this one?
editor.mineRemove: Remove “{name}” from your animations? (Presentations that use it keep their copy.)
editor.mineExportTooltip: Your animations as a .json file (for another browser, or another person)
editor.mineImportTooltip: Add the animations of such a .json file to yours
editor.mineEmpty: You have no animations of your own yet.
editor.mineImportNone: No animations found in that file.
editor.mineNoStorage: This browser does not keep your animations (storage is off).
editor.mineImportReplace: {count} of these have the same name as one of yours ({names}). Replace yours? (Cancel: yours stay, the others are added.)
editor.mineImportNothingNew: Nothing new in that file: you have all of these already.
editor.timedPathTooltip: The path keeps the speed you draw it with: slow where you go slowly; it lasts as long as you took (and starts at the red line when it stands on a moment)
editor.tlEaseTooltip: How the selected ◆ move on (or the selected element's whole animation); right-click a line between two ◆ does the same
editor.tlEaseDone: This part now moves: {name}. ▶ Play slide shows it.
editor.tlEaseNothing: Select ◆ in the timeline, or an element with an animation of its own.
editor.tlLaneRemove: Take this property out of the animation (all its key moments)
editor.tlLaneLast: An animation keeps at least one property.
editor.tlCopyNothing: Select ◆ in the timeline first (click, Shift+click or a box).
editor.tlCopied: {count} key moments copied: select an element with an animation of its own, put the red line on a moment, Ctrl+V.
cmd.stagger: Show selected items one by one (reading order)
editor.groupNeedsTwo: Shift+click two or more elements placed freely, then Ctrl+G.
editor.groupOnlyFree: Only elements placed freely can be grouped: Place freely first (Element tab).
editor.groupSameParent: These elements lie in different boxes: group elements that lie in the same box.
editor.ungroupNothing: Select a group (or an element in it) first.
editor.ungroupLost: Ungrouped: the group's own animation, morph name or rules are gone (its turn, layer and the way it appears went to its elements).
editor.staggerNote: Stagger: one after another, this many ms apart (rising in with the slide: at the slide's pace)
editor.staggerNeedsTwo: Shift+click two or more elements first.
editor.staggerShared: {count} elements share their animation with others: left as they are (Copy for this element first).
editor.key_ctrlGText: Group the selected elements placed freely / ungroup
editor.groupStaysFree: A group is always placed freely: Ctrl+Shift+G ungroups it.
cmd.textLinkTooltip: A link on these words: an address, or a slide of this file (#its-name)
editor.linkNoSlide: There is no slide named "{name}" in this file (the name is in the slide's settings).
editor.linkRefused: Only web addresses (https://…), mail (mailto:…) or a slide of this file (#name) can be a link.
editor.shape_circleTooltip: Goes round in a circle and comes back where it is (clockwise)
editor.shape_arcTooltip: Jumps up and over to the right
editor.shape_eightTooltip: A figure 8 on its side, back where it is
editor.reverseTooltip: Play this animation backwards (a rise-in becomes a sink-out). A shared or ready-made animation is copied first.
editor.reverseAlternate: This animation plays there and back already: backwards it looks the same.
editor.alignNeedsFree: Only an element placed freely can be lined up on the slide.
cmd.alignOnSlide: Line it up on the slide
editor.alignTurnedGroup: This element lies in a turned group: line up the group instead (or ungroup first).
editor.historyPathPoint: Key moment added on the path
editor.historyPathPointRemove: Key moment of the path removed
editor.pathPointTooClose: Too close to a key moment that is there: double-click a bit further along the line.
editor.pathSmoothTooltip: Make the path a smooth curve through its key moments (more key moments in between; its easings per piece go)
editor.pathSmoothNeedsThree: A path needs three key moments or more to bend: add one (double-click the line).
editor.pathSmoothTooMany: This path has too many key moments to smooth further.
editor.pathSmoothed: Smoothed: {count} key moments along a curve.
editor.originNote: The point this animation turns around and grows from (the element's own rotation keeps its middle).
cmd.selectLike: Select all of the same kind
editor.menuSelectLike: Select all of the same kind
editor.selectAllNone: Select all picks the elements placed freely (text boxes, shapes, labels, pictures you placed). This slide has none: click an element to select it.
editor.frontAlready: In front: nothing else lay over it.
editor.selectLikeOnly: It is the only one of its kind on this slide.
editor.selectAllDone: {count} selected: drag, align, style or delete them together.
editor.sameSizeNone: Nothing to resize: same width and height work on elements placed freely (right-click › Place freely). Blocks in the layout take their size from the layout, and a text's height follows its words.
editor.selectLikeInGroup: This element lies in a group: select the group (or ungroup first).
cmd.exportNoPresenter: Save a copy without the presenter view…
cmd.exportSlidesOnly: Save a copy with the slides only (no editor, no presenter view)…
cmd.insertChevron: Insert a chevron, a step of a process (shape)
editor.progressNote: The bar fills to this when the slide comes on (or on its click); the number next to it follows. Type in the label on the slide.
cmd.textMarkerTooltip: Marker: a highlighter stroke behind the words (drawn in when they appear)
editor.bulletsNote: For every point of this list. Ctrl+D (Duplicate) on a point adds one.
cmd.insertLabel: Insert a label (a text in a badge)
editor.tableNote: After (or at) the selected cell. Click a cell to type in it; Tab goes to the next.
editor.tableKeepRow: A table keeps its heading row and one row.
editor.tableUseButtons: A table gets rows and columns with + Row and + Column (Element tab, Table).
editor.tableRowsNeedTwo: Add a row first: with one row there is nothing to come one after another.
editor.tableRowsClickTable: This table appears on a click: choose One per click for its rows (one after another happens when the slide comes on).
editor.kenBurns: Slow zoom while the slide shows (Ken Burns)
editor.footer_both: A text and the slide number
editor.deckFooterNote: At the bottom of every slide (also in print and PDF). A slide can leave it out (Slide tab).
editor.newColumnText: A few lines about it. Click to type.
cmd.insertRoadmap: Insert a roadmap (a line with milestones)
editor.shapeDraw: Draws itself in (its lines first, then its fill)
editor.swapNeedsTwo: Select exactly two elements placed freely to swap their places.
editor.lockedLeftOut: {count} locked (Layers tab): left where it is.
editor.gridTooBig: These are too big to fit on the slide in a grid.
editor.swapLocked: One of the two is locked (Layers tab): unlock it to swap their places.
editor.followNeedsTwo: Select two: the element that moves, then the shape it follows (Shift+click).
editor.followNeedsShape: Select the element first, then the shape whose outline it should follow.
editor.followNeedsFree: The element that moves must be placed freely (Place freely).
editor.followTurned: The shape is turned: set its Rotation to 0 to follow its outline.
editor.linkBack: Next on that slide comes back here
editor.authorNotePlaceholder: e.g. check this number with Ann
editor.authorNoteNote: Only in the editor (a dashed violet outline; listed in the Slide tab). Never shown when presenting, left out of the copies without editor.
editor.checkAllGood: Nothing left to look at: no notes, missing links, images without a description, slides without a title or placeholder texts.
editor.checkLink: links to "{name}", a slide that is not there
editor.checkAlt: an image without a description (for screen readers)
editor.focus: Dim the rest on this click (until the next one)
editor.guideAddX: A guide from top to bottom (drag it; out of the slide or double-click: gone; elements snap to it)
editor.guideAddY: A guide from left to right (drag it; out of the slide or double-click: gone; elements snap to it)
editor.guideAdded: A guide in the middle: drag it where you want it (Alt: off the grid).
editor.guideTooltip: Your guide: drag to move (Alt: off the grid), out of the slide or double-click to remove
editor.groupFreedToMove: Placed freely where they were, so they move together (Undo puts them back in the layout).
editor.flipNotText: Only shapes, and images and videos in a frame, can be flipped (a text would read backwards).
cmd.layerForward: One layer forward (above the next one)
cmd.layerBack: One layer back (under the next one)
editor.layerFrontAlready: It is already the frontmost here (To the front: above everything).
editor.layerBackAlready: It is already the backmost here (To the back: behind the slide's own texts and images).
cmd.zoomSelection: Zoom in on the selection (Shift+1: the whole slide)
editor.key_zoomSelectionText: Zoom in on the selection / the whole slide again
editor.copyToSlidesTooltip: The same element, in the same place, on the slides you tick (a badge, a logo, a shape)
editor.copyToNone: Tick one or more slides first.
editor.copyToDone: Copied to {count} slide(s). Undo takes them all away again.
editor.pastedTable: Pasted as a table (the first row as its headings). Undo for nothing.
editor.pastedList: Pasted as a list, one point per line. Undo for nothing.
editor.itemsClickBlock: This block appears on a click: choose One per click or Together for its items (one after another happens when the slide comes on).
editor.itemsHaveClicks: Some of its items hold clicks of their own: set those first (or choose the items with Shift+click).
editor.linkUrl: Or a web address (opens in a new tab)
editor.fillNoGroup: A group cannot fill an area (its elements would not follow): ungroup it, or fill each element.
editor.backgroundDrift: Moves slowly while the slide is shown
editor.stepZoomIn: Zoom in on it on this click (until the next one)
editor.countUpOnTooltip: The number in this text counts up when it appears (as the number blocks do)
editor.countUpDone: {number} now counts up: its start, time and separator are under Number.
editor.connectTooClose: They are too close together (or overlap) for an arrow between them.
editor.connectFollow: Follows the two elements (when they move)
editor.connectUnlinked: This arrow no longer follows its two elements (moved by hand). Undo to connect it again.
editor.duplicateGlideTooltip: Duplicate to glide: a copy right after this slide whose blocks glide to where you put them there (morph)
cmd.duplicateGlide: Duplicate the slide to glide (morph: move things on the copy, they glide there)
editor.duplicateGlideDone: Copy made, right after the original. Move, resize or recolour things on this copy: when you present, they glide there from the slide before.
editor.blockIcon: Icon (a symbol in a round badge)
cmd.insertIcon: Insert an icon (a symbol in a round badge)
editor.iconPick: Icon: pick one, or type your own (an emoji, a letter, a number) in it.
editor.progressLine: Progress line at the bottom (how far the talk is)
editor.progressLineNote: A thin bar that grows with every slide of the talk (not on backup slides); you see it when you present.
editor.shapeTextAdd: T Add a text in it
editor.transitionPush: Push (the new slide pushes the old one out)
editor.transitionCover: Cover (the new slide slides in over the old one)
editor.arrangeGapTooltip: The gap between them (px), for In a row, In a column and Arrange in a grid
editor.repeatNote: Repeat: this many side by side (→) or one under the other (↓), the gap of In a row, all selected:
editor.repeatTooWide: {count} side by side would not fit on the slide: move it left, choose fewer, or a smaller gap.
editor.transitionUncover: Uncover (the old slide slides away, the new one is underneath)
editor.repeatTooTall: {count} one under the other would not fit on the slide: move it up, choose fewer, or a smaller gap.
editor.keepRatio: Keeps its proportions (corners, and Width or Height here; Shift frees them)
editor.textFillOutline: Outline (only the edges of the letters)
editor.boxFrosted: Blurred glass (blurs what is behind it)
editor.transitionWipe: Wipe (the new slide is drawn open over the old one)
editor.transitionCircle: Circle (the new slide opens from the middle)
editor.fitText: A↕ Fit the text to its box
editor.fitTextTooltip: The largest text size at which all of this text fits in its box (it has a height of its own)
editor.fitTextNoRoom: Even very small, this text does not fit in its box: make the box bigger first.
editor.slideAdvanceNote: Empty: you click. A number: its next click (or the next slide) comes by itself after that many seconds, each time.
editor.deckLoop: Self-running: after the last slide, start again (with slides that move on by themselves)
editor.slideSkip: Hide this slide (skipped when presenting; it stays in the slide list)
editor.transitionCube: Cube (the slides turn like the sides of a cube)
editor.transitionSplit: Split (the new slide opens from the middle to both sides)
editor.confetti: 🎉 Confetti, stars or hearts when it appears
editor.transitionTilesNote: Point at a picture to see that transition; click it to choose it.
editor.frameCaptionNote: Handwritten on the polaroid's bottom edge (up to 60 characters).
editor.imageLookDuotoneNote: A duotone image cannot blur or glow on its own click, its own animations with a filter (blur, brightness) jump, and it dims at once (Dim the rest). Put those on its frame instead.
cmd.settingGone: That setting is not there now.
cmd.selectForSettings: Select an element on the slide to find its settings here too.
cmd.sameWidth: Same width as the first selected
cmd.sameHeight: Same height as the first selected
cmd.arrangeGrid: Arrange the selected in a grid
cmd.needsSeveral: Shift+click two or more elements first
cmd.dropOnlyImages: Only pictures can be dropped on the slide.
cmd.hintDrop: or drag a picture from your computer onto the slide
cmd.overflowTooltip: Something on this slide goes below its bottom edge and will not be seen. Make a text shorter, remove a block, or Place it freely.
cmd.settingScripted: not on a slide run by a script
cmd.settingNotNow: not available for this element now
editor.insertFreeTip: Placed freely: drag it anywhere on the slide
cmd.welcomeSelect: Click anything on the slide to select it: its settings appear on the right.
cmd.welcomeType: Double-click a text to type in it. Drag an element to move it, a corner to size it.
cmd.welcomeInsert: + Insert (top bar) adds text, pictures, charts and shapes. You can also drag a picture onto the slide.
cmd.welcomeFind: Can't find something? Press Ctrl+K and type it in your own words: "shadow", "transparent", "go to 5".
cmd.welcomeUndo: Ctrl+Z undoes anything, Ctrl+S saves, F5 plays the presentation from this slide.
editor.exportPdfNote: A new tab opens the print window: choose "Save as PDF" as the printer.
toast.popupBlockedTab: The browser blocked the new tab. Allow pop-ups for this file, then try again.
editor.adjustReset: Brightness, contrast and colour as they were
cmd.panelStartHint: Click anything on the slide to change it, or + Insert (top bar) to add something. Below: this slide's own settings.
cmd.overflowPicked: This block runs off the slide: make it smaller, remove it, or Place it freely (Layout).
editor.moreTextOptions: More text options (font, weight, slant, spacing, …)
editor.themeGalleryNote: A click uses that theme for every slide (saved into the file with Save). Single colours: Theme and colours…
cmd.comment: Add a comment to the selected element
editor.badgeCommentsTooltip: This slide has comments (listed in its Slide tab)
editor.cropTooltip: Choose which part of the picture shows
editor.cropNote: Drag the frame to move it, a corner to make it larger or smaller. It keeps the shape of the picture's box, so nothing is stretched.
editor.cropNotLoaded: The picture has not loaded yet: try again in a moment.
editor.accentWhole: The whole element is in the accent colour now. (Select a few words first to colour only those.)
editor.boldByDesign: It is bold already: the slide design makes this text bold. To make it lighter: More text options › Weight. Highlight (amber) makes words stand out.
editor.boldWhole: The whole element is bold now. (Select a few words first to make only those bold.)
editor.boldWholeOff: The whole element is not bold any more.
editor.plainWhole: Its own colour and weight again.
editor.plainAlready: It is plain already: as the slide design makes it. (Select a few words to make only those plain.)
editor.placedFreelyToSize: Placed freely, so you can size it (Layout › Place freely; Ctrl+Z puts it back in its place).
editor.themeBack: To go back: Ctrl+Z, or click “{name}”.
editor.changeLayoutTooltip: Make this slide again in another layout: its title and texts go along
cmd.changeLayout: Change the layout of this slide…
editor.chooseNewLayout: Change layout: choose a new layout for this slide
editor.layoutChanged: New layout: its title and texts came along (Ctrl+Z: the old layout).
editor.layoutChangedNotes: New layout. {count} text(s) had no place: they are in the speaker notes now (Ctrl+Z: the old layout).
editor.scriptedNoLayout: This slide is run by a script: its layout stays as it is.
cmd.slideAdvance: Move on by itself after … seconds…
cmd.slideSkip: Hide this slide (skipped when presenting) on / off
editor.grouped: Grouped {count} elements: they move and size together (Ctrl+Shift+G takes them apart).
editor.escapeAgain: Press Esc again to close the editor.
cmd.transitionAll: Use this slide's transition on every slide
editor.skipOn: Hidden: presenting skips this slide; it stays in the list (open it there or from the chapter list when needed).
editor.skipOff: Shown again: presenting includes this slide.
editor.snapOn: Snap on: what you drag lines up with the grid, the guides and the other elements.
editor.snapOff: Snap off: what you drag goes exactly where you let go.
editor.gridOn: Grid on: elements snap to it when you move them (G).
editor.chooseVideo: Choose a video file (mp4 or webm) from your computer.
editor.quickApplied: {what}: {name}. ▶ Play slide (Animations tab) shows it again.
editor.quickRemoved: No animation of its own any more: it rises in with the slide as usual.
editor.appearEarlier: Comes in earlier (before the one above)
editor.appearLater: Comes in later (after the one below)
editor.appearWithOwnAnimation: Its animation “{name}” plays then (Animation, below, changes how it moves).
editor.slidesPicked: {count} slides selected: “Use on the selected slides” (Slide tab) changes only those. A click without Ctrl ends it.
cmd.checkDeck: Check the presentation for loose ends
editor.clickOnlyNote: For an element that appears on a click: set Appears to On a click first.
cmd.tipPicture: 💡 Picture: drag a corner to size it; ✂ Crop, Look and Frame are in the panel; drop another picture on the slide to add it.
cmd.tipChart: 💡 Chart: double-click it to type its numbers (one row per line, like “2026: 92”).
cmd.tipNumber: 💡 Number: double-click it to change it; “How it counts” can make it roll like a counter.
cmd.tipShape: 💡 Shape: drag to move it, a corner to size it, Ctrl+drag for a copy; Fill and Outline are in the panel.
cmd.tipList: 💡 List: each point can come on its own click (Appears › On a click, or Its items appear: One per click).
cmd.tipText: 💡 Text: click to type; select words for bold, colour or a link; Ctrl+K finds any setting in your own words.
cmd.tipsAgain: Show the small tips again (one per kind of element)
cmd.tipsReset: The tips show again, once for each kind of element.
editor.standOutTooltip: An edge, a light tint and a glow in the accent colour, in one click (again: off)
editor.standOutOn: It stands out now: edge, tint and glow (one click again takes them off).
editor.codeExpertNote: For experts: the code behind the slides. Everything here can also be done with the other tabs.
editor.numberKeptWithin: That number is kept between {min} and {max}.
editor.key_f2Text: Type in the selected text (the caret at the end)
editor.key_shiftF10Text: The right-click menu of the selected element
editor.key_f6Text: The keyboard to the slide, the slide list or the panel (↑ ↓ choose a slide there)
editor.statusWordsAll: {count} words on all slides (without the speaker notes)
editor.key_ctrlFText: Find and replace text on all slides
controls.pen: Draw on the slide (D; H: highlighter, X: wipe, Esc: stop)
keys.pen: Pen: draw on the slide (again: stop)
keys.wipeInk: Wipe the drawing on this slide
toast.penOn: Pen: draw on the slide with the mouse. X wipes, Esc stops.
toast.highlighterOn: Highlighter: draw over what matters. X wipes, Esc stops.
toast.inkOff: Drawing off (the lines stay on the slide; X wipes them)
toast.inkWiped: The drawing on this slide is wiped
cmd.insertSound: Insert a sound or background music…
editor.soundHidden: Hide the sound icon while presenting
editor.soundNote: Plays only on this slide, on the big screen (the audience window); it stops when the slide goes. Type over its name to rename it.
editor.chooseSound: Choose a sound file (mp3, m4a, wav or ogg) from your computer.
toast.soundBlocked: The browser held back the sound: click once in this window, then show the slide again.
cmd.importSlides: Add slides from another presentation file (.html)…
editor.importNote: Click the slides you want (again: not), then Insert. They keep their texts, pictures, sounds and animations. Code written in that file (slide scripts, its own look for its slides) does not come along, so a slide may look a little different here.
editor.importNone: {file} has no slides made with this program.
editor.importUnreadable: That file could not be read.
editor.imported: {count} slides inserted (Ctrl+Z takes them out again)
cmd.resetLayout: Reset the layout (moved parts and their order back in place)
editor.resetNothing: Nothing to reset: every part of the layout is in its place and order (text boxes and shapes stay where you put them).
editor.resetDone: The layout is as it was ({count} put back; Ctrl+Z undoes it)
editor.quickWhenClick: {what} now waits for a click (▶ Play slide, then Next click, shows it)
editor.tabDeckTooltip: Theme, colours, fonts, footer and settings of all slides
cmd.penHelp: How to draw on the slide while presenting
editor.penHelp: While presenting: D (or the brush button on the bottom bar) draws, H highlights, X wipes, Esc stops drawing.
editor.boldAlready: This text is bold already, so Bold shows little: Highlight (amber) makes words stand out here.
cmd.slideBackup: Extra slide, shown only when asked (backup) on / off
editor.backupOn: An extra slide now: the talk skips it; open it from the Slides drawer or the chapter list when asked.
editor.keysFind: Find a key: type what it does (copy, slide, pen…)
editor.spellHow: A word with a red line may be misspelled: right-click it for the browser's corrections, or type over it.
editor.spellEnd: Spelling checked: that was the last text of the last slide.
editor.spellFirst: That was the first text of the first slide.
editor.key_f7Text: Check spelling: the next (previous) text with the keyboard in it; Esc stops
editor.playOpened: Presenting in a new tab, from this slide. Esc or closing that tab brings you back here.
editor.advanceAllTooltip: The same time on every slide (for a screen that runs by itself)
editor.textScaleNote: Everything on the slides grows a little with it: the status bar warns when something no longer fits.
editor.sampleTextTooltip: Example text: click and type over it
editor.slideDuplicated: Slide copied: this is the copy, right after the original. Give it a title of its own in the Slide tab.
editor.pinNoRoom: Pinned: it stays open once the window is wider. In this narrow window it opens from its tab at the edge, so the slide keeps its room.
editor.commentScripted: No comments on this slide's elements: the slide has its own animation script. Write it in the speaker notes instead (Slide tab).
editor.slideDeleted: Slide "{title}" deleted. Ctrl+Z brings it back.
cmd.insertLink: Link to a website or slide…
cmd.linkHow: Select a few words on the slide (or an element), then Link.
editor.checkOverflow: has content that runs off the bottom of the slide
editor.freeLeavesLayout: Placed freely: it stays where it was, but no longer takes room in the layout, so the blocks around it close up. Drag it where you want it (Ctrl+Z undoes).
editor.freeCoversText: It lies over the slide's text: drag it to a free place, or Arrange › To the back.
editor.shapeCoversText: The shape lies over the slide's text: drag it to a free place, or Arrange › To the back.
editor.quickReplaced: (It replaces {old}: an element has one animation; Ctrl+Z brings it back.)
editor.animAfterPreviousTooltip: Its delay becomes the moment the last animation before it on this slide ends
editor.animNothingBefore: Nothing before it comes in with the slide: it can start at once (delay 0).
editor.animAfterPreviousDone: It now starts after the one before: at {seconds} s.
editor.copyAgain: This element was copied in another tab or before the page was opened: copy it again here.
editor.imageFitNote: Works when the image has a box of its own: Place freely, then a Height.
editor.timing: Starts at {start} ms, moves for {length} ms
editor.groupNeedsFree: {count} of the selected elements sit in the layout and cannot move: right-click each › Place freely first.
editor.spreadNeedsThree: Spreading needs at least three freely placed elements.
editor.findEmpty: Type the words to find first.
editor.replacedCount: Replaced {count}× on {slides} slides (Undo takes it back).
editor.key_shiftClickText: Select several elements: align, spread, move or delete them together
editor.key_altDragText: Place without snapping to the grid or guides
editor.key_doubleClickText: A text box there, ready to type in (right-click an empty spot: a text box or shape there)
editor.key_rightClickText: Menu: copy, cut, paste, duplicate, delete, select the block that holds it, place freely, front / back, copy / paste style, lock, the slide's animations and layers
editor.replacedCountOne: Replaced {count}× on 1 slide (Undo takes it back).
editor.pickColour: Pick a colour from the screen
editor.pickColourTooltip: Click anywhere on the screen to take that colour (Esc cancels)
editor.groupAppearNote: How they appear, in reading order (top to bottom, left to right):
editor.groupAppearDone: Done: the Animations tab shows the order (▶ Play slide plays it).
editor.groupAppearSkipped: {count} with their own animation stay as they are: their animation decides.
editor.dragTiming: drag the bar: earlier or later
editor.key_zoomText: Zoom the slide in / out / fit it again (also Ctrl+wheel, and while typing)
editor.layersNote: Every element of this slide, in the order of the file (a later one lies on top; freely placed ones lie above the rest, and To the front / To the back change that). Click to select, Shift+click to add to the selection or take out again, double-click to give it a name. 👁 hides an element while you edit, to reach what is under it; 🔒 locks it, so it cannot be clicked, dragged, moved or deleted, not even with the block that holds it (it does go along when that block moves); nothing new goes inside a locked block. Presenting shows the slide as always.
editor.noLayers: This slide has no elements yet.
editor.layerLock: Lock: no clicking, dragging, moving or deleting
editor.layerHidden: Hidden while you edit (presenting still shows it)
editor.layerLocked: Locked: unlock it in the Layers tab
editor.lockedNote: This element is locked: unlock it in the Layers tab first.
editor.copyStyleTooltip: Copy the look set in the editor: size, colour, alignment, font… (Ctrl+Alt+C)
editor.pasteStyleTooltip: Give the copied look to the selected element(s) (Ctrl+Alt+V)
editor.styleCopied: Style copied: select an element and press Ctrl+Alt+V (or Paste style)
editor.noStyleCopied: Copy a style first (Ctrl+Alt+C, or Copy style)
editor.key_ctrlDragText: Leave a copy where the element was (also with several selected)
editor.key_ctrlAltCVText: Copy the look of an element / give it to the selected element(s)
editor.noOwnStyle: Nothing to copy yet: this element still looks as the slide's design makes it. Change its size or colour first (Style), then Copy style.
editor.lockedWithin: Something inside is locked: unlock it in the Layers tab first.
editor.lockedInside: This block is locked in the Layers tab: unlock it to add something inside it.
editor.dragToResizeCorner: Drag to resize (Shift: keep the proportions, or free them for a picture; Ctrl: from the middle)
editor.gridTooltip: Show a grid on the slide while editing (G)
editor.snapTooltip: Snap to the grid, the middle and other elements while dragging (off: place freely, as with Alt)
editor.lineUpBox: Line up in the block it is placed in:
editor.key_shiftCornerText: Keep the proportions (a picture keeps them anyway: Shift frees them)
editor.key_altHoverText: The distances between it and the selection
editor.key_gridText: Show or hide the grid (Snap, next to it, switches snapping on or off)
editor.elementNameNote: Only for the editor: shown in the Layers and Animations tabs. Double-click its row in the Layers tab to rename it there. Empty: its text.
editor.copyAppearTooltip: Copy how this element appears: with the slide or on which click, its effect, speed and easing
editor.pasteAppearTooltip: Let the selected element(s) appear the same way
editor.appearCopied: Appearance copied: select an element and press Paste appearance
editor.appearSkipped: ({count} with an animation of their own left alone)
editor.overviewTooltip: All slides large in one window: click to open, drag to move (O)
editor.overviewTitle: All slides: click one to open it, drag one to move it
editor.key_frontBackText: A freely placed element one layer forward / back; with Shift: to the front / to the back (the two keys right of P on a US keyboard; the same keys on others)
editor.key_overviewText: Overview of all slides (click to open, drag to move)
editor.previewAppearTooltip: Play how this element appears (as in the presentation)
editor.previewNothing: Nothing to play: this element has no movement when it appears
editor.transitionAllTooltip: Give every slide this transition (one undo step)
editor.backgroundAllTooltip: Give every slide this background: colour, image, darkening and gradient (one undo step)
editor.usedOnEverySlide: Done: {count} other slides changed (Ctrl+Z takes it back)
editor.dragToRotate: Drag to turn it (Shift: steps of 15°; it snaps to 0°, 45°, 90° … Alt: not)
editor.key_shiftRotateText: Turn the element in steps of 15° (without: it snaps to 0°, 45°, 90° …)
editor.previewTransitionTooltip: Play how this slide comes on after the slide before it (a click ends it)
editor.historyTooltip: History: the last changes; click one to go back to just before it
editor.placedFreelyToast: Placed freely. Ctrl+Z puts it back in the layout.
editor.autoHeightTooltip: As high as its text again (no height of its own)
editor.key_ctrlShiftSizeText: Text of the selected element(s) one size bigger / smaller (the keys of > and < on a US keyboard; the same keys by position on others)
editor.imageZoomNote: Shows a part of the image larger, in the same box; Focus picks the part
editor.imageFocusNote: Which part stays in view when the image is cut to fill its box
